title: PermissionCatalog
description: Closed, code-owned catalog of global permissions. Each key names a real enforcement point in the GraphQL shield (operation -> permission). Roles (DB data) bundle these keys; a permission has meaning only at its enforcement point, so the catalog is decoupled as DATA but closed in lifecycle (a new key ships with a new gate). Keys are dotted/namespaced (readable, scope-friendly) and therefore exposed over the API as String + catalog-validated, not as a GraphQL enum.

network.statistics.read.description: Read network-wide statistics and pinned-post counts.

role.manage.description: Manage roles and their permissions, and assign/unassign roles to users.

policy.manage.description: View and change network policy settings (defaults, set, reset).

apiKey.administer.description: Administer other users' API keys (list and revoke).

user.email.readAny.description: Read any user's email address (beyond one's own).

user.delete.any.description: Delete any user's account, subject to the act-on hierarchy — you can only delete a user whose permissions are a strict subset of yours (own-account deletion stays self-allowed).

badge.manage.description: Grant and revoke verification and trophy badges.

content.moderate.description: Access reports and review (decide) on reported content.

user.disable.description: Disable (deactivate) and re-enable user accounts (reversible), subject to the act-on hierarchy — you can only disable a user whose permissions are a strict subset of yours.

post.create.description: Create posts (still subject to group membership where applicable).

comment.create.description: Comment on posts (still subject to group membership where applicable).

socialMedia.create.description: Add social-media links to one's own profile.

user.invite.description: Generate personal invite codes to invite people to the network.

videoCall.create_public.description: Start (open) a video call in a public group. Joining an existing call stays open to any member.

videoCall.create_closed.description: Start (open) a video call in a closed group. Joining an existing call stays open to any member.

videoCall.create_hidden.description: Start (open) a video call in a hidden group. Joining an existing call stays open to any member.

apiKey.create.description: Create personal API keys for backend access (managing/revoking existing keys stays available).
